an5.101:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, paññavā hoti.
an5.101:2.1: yaṃ kho bhikkhave assaddhassa sārajjaṃ hoti, saddhassa taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti.
an5.101:3.1: yaṃ bhikkhave dussīlassa sārajjaṃ hoti, sīlavato taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti.
an5.101:4.1: yaṃ bhikkhave appassutassa sārajjaṃ hoti, bahussutassa taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti.
an5.101:5.1: yaṃ bhikkhave kusītassa sārajjaṃ hoti, āraddhaviriyassa taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti.
an5.101:6.1: yaṃ bhikkhave duppaññassa sārajjaṃ hoti, paññavato taṃ sārajjaṃ na hoti.
an5.101:6.3: ime kho bhikkhave pañca sekhavesārajjakaraṇā dhammāti.
